ValidationRule.description: If Stage = Application Submitted to School then "Allow parallel processing of application" should be True.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name ='Application(Opt-In)',ISPICKVAL( Stage__c , 'Application submitted to School'), Allow_parallel_processing_of_Application__c !=TRUE )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please check Allow parallel processing of Application when Stage is Application submitted to School
